description: This file defines classes and enums related to CAC (Channel Access Control) capabilities in a Wi-Fi mapping context, including data structures for radio capabilities, types, and operating classes, with auto-generated code for handling TLV (Type-Length-Value) data.

classes.name: tlvProfile2CacCapabilities
classes.description: Represents a TLV structure for CAC capabilities, including methods for parsing, creating, and managing CAC radio and type data.

classes.name: cCacCapabilitiesRadio
classes.description: Represents radio-specific CAC capabilities, including radio UID and supported CAC types.

classes.name: cCacTypes
classes.description: Represents CAC type information, including CAC method, duration, and operating classes.

classes.name: cCacCapabilitiesOperatingClasses
classes.description: Represents operating class details, including operating class ID, number of channels, and channel list.

methods.name: tlvProfile2CacCapabilities
methods.description: Constructor for parsing or creating CAC capabilities TLV from buffer or base class.

methods.name: add_cac_radios
methods.description: Adds a cCacCapabilitiesRadio instance to the CAC capabilities.

methods.name: cac_radios
methods.description: Retrieves a specific CAC radio by index.

methods.name: add_operating_classes
methods.description: Adds an operating class to the CAC type.

methods.name: operating_classes
methods.description: Retrieves a specific operating class by index.

methods.name: set_channels
methods.description: Sets the channels for an operating class.
